text_block_list.text:
Upon becoming Sirius Symboli's trainer, I 
was to have a new suit tailored by the 
shop her family frequents.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Why? Ha! Did you honestly expect to stand 
beside me in an off-the-rack suit?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So, what model should we go with? British, 
or Classico... We're making a three-piece, 
so the sky's the limit.

"I don't know... I'm a complete amateur 
when it comes to suits. However, as Sirius 
Symboli's Trainer, I have no intention of 
giving up my say—in that case..."
choice_data_list:
...I want to use your racing outfit for 
reference!

...I want to use your racing outfit for 
reference!

text_block_list.text:
Her racing outfit resembles a suit as 
well. Perhaps we can get some kind of hint 
from it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Ignorance is powerlessness, isn't it, 
pup? However...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you credit for struggling 
despite your ignorance. —Time for a 
special lesson.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
In my case, the overall style is "Modern 
Classic." As a counterpart to the orthodox 
"Modern British," I adopted a distinct, 
characterful Italian style.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
And I won't stand for anything 
old-fashioned. Flat-front, low-rise slacks 
to keep the silhouette simple.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The jacket also received 'sizing' 
—removing nearly all excess slack to 
create a stylish, modern silhouette.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Listen. A suit is a 'language.' Through 
its cut and craftsmanship, it conveys your 
intent and stance."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, custom orders require both 
knowledge and experience. You ought to 
learn at least this much yourself.

text_block_list.name: Tailor
text_block_list.text:
With all due respect, Sirius-sama. It is 
because most people cannot do that that 
they seek the help of professionals like 
us.

text_block_list.name: Tailor
text_block_list.text:
Very few people take the initiative to 
acquire specialized knowledge and actually 
put it into words like Lady Sirius does.

text_block_list.name: Tailor
text_block_list.text:
"When you walked into the shop wearing a 
school backpack and said, 'I want to learn 
about suits,' I was truly astonished—"

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text: Hey. I'm borrowing this book.

text_block_list.name: Tailor
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, of course I don't mind. Are you 
studying tailoring?

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
"Since I've decided to base my racewear on 
a suit, I want to acquire the knowledge 
necessary to have it custom-made."

text_block_list.name: Tailor
text_block_list.text:
! Is that so... In that case, take this. 
That material is advanced, so let's start 
from the basics.

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text: ...Then I'll borrow that too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, it's already decided that I'll be 
wearing my racewear. It's only natural to 
prepare for it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Racing silks are "the symbol of oneself" 
presented to the world.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Just 'cause I lack the know-how doesn't 
mean I'm gonna leave my choices up to 
someone else.

Not just anyone can wear a Racewear. 
Yet... she believed she could, and poured 
every ounce of effort into making it 
reality.

And that is why she is so full of 
confidence. If I am to stand beside 
someone like her, then I—
choice_data_list: ...Um, can I place an order, please?!

We've got to do our best so you can pull 
it off!

text_block_list.name: Tailor
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am listening.
choice_data_list:
So the red flower worn at the awards 
ceremony stands out—

text_block_list.text:
"I want you to prepare her to shine 
brightest right after Sirius Symboli's 
glorious victory." ...That's what I told 
them.

text_block_list.name: Tailor
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You mean that red ornamental flower, 
don't you? Yes, yes. Understood 
completely.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! I see... You've got quite the 
mouth on you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
In that case, finishing touches on that 
suit fall to me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Hell yeah. Since you picked me, I'll make 
you the finest custom-tailored suit that 
only you can pull off!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "Hah! What a silly little puppy."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Listen. A suit looks at its best when you 
puff out your chest and stand proudly."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
When you put on this suit, there's no way 
it could be for anything else... right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh. ...Well, you'd better practice 
turning on the charm as best as you can!
